us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump approval falls to 33% in Reuters/Ipsos poll
bullets: Reuters/Ipsos found President Donald Trump’s approval at 33%.
The poll cited public concern over prices and the Iran conflict.
The survey was conducted from August 14 to August 17.

articles.title: Trump shrugs off suspected Russian hack of U.S. federal courts
bullets: Trump responded publicly to reports of a suspected Russian-linked court-system hack.
The issue involves U.S. federal court technology and cybersecurity concerns.
Officials have been assessing possible exposure of sensitive court data.

articles.title: Palm Beach airport code switches from PBI to DJT
bullets: The IATA passenger code change took effect on August 18, 2026.
Travelers were told to use PBI until the transition date.
The airport was renamed President Donald J. Trump International Airport under Florida law.

articles.title: Florida and Alaska hold key 2026 primary contests
bullets: Several Florida statewide and U.S. House primaries are scheduled for August 18.
Alaska’s at-large House primary is also on the calendar.
The races form part of the 2026 midterm election cycle.

articles.title: Trump says U.S. will not extend Iran memorandum
bullets: Trump said the U.S. was not seeking an extension of the Iran memorandum of understanding.
The comments came as tensions persisted around the Strait of Hormuz.
Energy markets watched the remarks for oil-supply implications.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international stories and geopolitical risks

articles.title: Iran says Hormuz will stay shut until U.S. meets interim deal terms
bullets: Iran said the Strait of Hormuz would remain shut until its conditions are met.
The strait remains central to global oil and gas shipping flows.
The dispute follows the collapse of a U.S.-Iran negotiating deadline.

articles.title: Trump threatens Oman over Hormuz diplomacy
bullets: Trump warned Oman against interfering with U.S. efforts involving Hormuz.
Oman has been involved in regional mediation with Iran.
The comment drew attention because Oman is a longtime U.S. security partner.

articles.title: Gulf allies show frustration with U.S. handling of Iran crisis
bullets: Gulf officials have voiced concern over U.S. diplomacy in the Iran conflict.
Regional governments are seeking ways to protect energy and shipping interests.
The tensions have complicated U.S. relations with Persian Gulf partners.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV’s AI encyclical published
bullets: Magnifica Humanitas was published on August 18, 2026.
The text focuses on human dignity in the age of artificial intelligence.
The book’s listing includes coverage references from AP and The Washington Post.

articles.title: U.S. and NATO continue work on Ukraine security guarantee options
bullets: Military planners have explored possible post-conflict security guarantees for Ukraine.
The discussions follow U.S. pledges to help protect Ukraine under a settlement.
The issue remains linked to wider negotiations over Russia’s war.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from current reporting

articles.title: Supreme Court orders national action on elephant corridors
bullets: India’s Supreme Court directed the Centre to survey elephant corridors nationwide.
The court said states cannot block ancient wild-elephant paths.
The Centre was asked to report progress within eight weeks.

articles.title: Commercial flights shift from Visakhapatnam to Bhogapuram airport
bullets: Scheduled commercial flights moved to Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport on August 17.
INS Dega is to close to commercial flights except military and emergency use.
The new airport was built at a reported cost of ₹4,727 crore.

articles.title: Bellandur police seize 800 kg of gelatin sticks near school
bullets: Police seized more than 800 kg of gelatin sticks at a Bhoganahalli construction site.
A company owner and site engineer were booked under explosives laws.
Residents had raised safety concerns over alleged blasting near a school.

articles.title: Education Minister meets NTA after UGC-NET re-conduct
bullets: Pralhad Joshi met NTA officials on August 17.
The agency removed more than 50 staff and sought new technology-security hires.
The minister ordered tighter exam protocols, including air-gapped systems.

articles.title: Telangana authorities act against rice millers over ₹238 crore default
bullets: Authorities registered seven criminal cases involving 38 rice millers in Peddapalli.
Officials cited defaults in custom-milled rice deliveries to FCI and state agencies.
Revenue recovery and inspections at mills were ordered.

articles.title: Stocks making big moves: Paramount Skydance, Cava, Capri and SailPoint
bullets: CNBC highlighted several midday stock movers in Tuesday trading.
Paramount Skydance, Cava, Capri and SailPoint were among the notable names.
The moves came during a broader risk-off session for major indexes.

articles.title: CoreWeave shares slump after wider-than-expected loss
bullets: CoreWeave fell sharply after reporting a wider-than-expected quarterly loss.
Investors also focused on the company’s coming lock-up expiration.
Analysts assessed the results against the stock’s AI-infrastructure valuation.

articles.title: Bullish shares more than double in NYSE debut
bullets: Crypto exchange Bullish surged after pricing its IPO above expectations.
The stock more than doubled in its first trading session.
The listing drew attention to renewed investor demand for crypto-related equities.

articles.title: Small caps rally as Magnificent Seven stocks roll over
bullets: Small-cap shares outperformed as mega-cap tech weakened.
The rotation reflected shifting investor appetite after a strong AI-led run.
Traders watched whether the move signaled a broader market leadership change.

articles.title: Memory-chip stocks retreat after recent surge
bullets: Micron and other memory-linked names drew selling pressure after recent gains.
Traders cited volatility in AI and semiconductor leadership.
The move weighed on chip-heavy benchmarks during the session.

articles.title: Walmart expands grocery discount for 1.6 million employees
bullets: Walmart expanded a grocery-discount benefit for about 1.6 million employees.
The move came as tariffs renewed inflation concerns for consumers.
The benefit targets everyday food costs for U.S. workers.

articles.title: Amazon launches same-day delivery of fresh groceries
bullets: Amazon expanded same-day delivery to meat, eggs and produce.
The move increases competition in U.S. grocery delivery.
Analysts viewed the push as a challenge to grocers and warehouse clubs.

articles.title: Port of Los Angeles importers rushed shipments before tariff deadline
bullets: U.S. companies accelerated imports through Los Angeles ahead of tariff deadlines.
The timing shifted after the administration pushed back a deadline.
The rush highlighted continued tariff uncertainty for retailers and manufacturers.

articles.title: Tom Dundon reaches deal to buy Portland Trail Blazers
bullets: Tom Dundon agreed to buy the Portland Trail Blazers from Paul Allen’s estate.
The sale would shift ownership of one of the NBA’s major franchises.
Financial terms and league approval were key next steps.

articles.title: Visa plans workforce cuts, Bloomberg reports
bullets: Visa reportedly planned to cut about 7% of its workforce.
The move was framed as part of corporate cost management.
Investors watched for effects on payments-sector margins and strategy.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic strike new hyperscaler agreements
bullets: AI labs continued signing infrastructure agreements with cloud providers.
The deals reflect heavy compute demand from frontier-model development.
Investors remain focused on whether AI spending can generate durable returns.

articles.title: Apple legal letters target former employees now at OpenAI
bullets: Apple reportedly sent legal preservation letters to former staff now working at OpenAI.
The dispute relates to alleged confidential information involving hardware plans.
OpenAI has denied interest in other companies’ trade secrets.

articles.title: AMD continues AI push after Taalas acquisition
bullets: AMD announced an acquisition of AI-inference chip startup Taalas earlier this month.
The deal supports AMD’s effort to compete deeper in AI hardware.
Investors are watching AMD’s AI infrastructure strategy against Nvidia and custom-chip rivals.

articles.title: Cisco earnings draw analyst focus on AI networking demand
bullets: Cisco earnings were a key tech event for the week.
Analysts focused on demand tied to AI networking and enterprise infrastructure.
The results were expected to offer signals on corporate technology spending.

articles.title: AI infrastructure spending remains a major market risk
bullets: Large technology firms continue spending heavily on AI data centers and chips.
Analysts warn that returns from the spending cycle remain uncertain.
The debate has affected valuations for cloud, semiconductor and software stocks.
